summary: Pinned candidate and frozen evidence match the bundle. The bounded host GCC verification passed, and the audited positive, negative, and recovery cases cover the accepted scope.
accepted_scope: Host GCC unit-test verification of USART1 921600 cascade observation and USART3 115200 non-blocking [TH-DBG] logging, runtime sensor and filament state synchronization, summaries limited to 2 Hz, and error, truncation, USART1 TX failure, and ring overflow recovery. The MCU diff is limited to the three allowed mcu-p3 paths; other repository diffs are empty. Bundle SHA256 and recorded evidence/diff hashes match. Cross-compiler ELF builds and physical MCU USB/UART HIL are excluded by the contract and are not treated as missing required checks. source_report is empty, so there is no report or report SHA256 to audit.
